answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting links each identity to a rolling behavioural cipher derived from its action sequences across prior epochs. An identity whose current-epoch behaviour diverges beyond a threshold from its own history is flagged and its influence capped until it re-passes consistency checks against a randomized tundra of held-out past tasks. Honest agents converge toward stable signatures; a sybil cluster must manufacture and maintain consistent histories for every fake identity, and that maintenance cost rises at the zenith of each epoch as history depth grows.
